_comment: Workbook exercise air-sat-reset (docs/workbook/air-sat-reset.md), irish-ahu part: a real unit whose supply-air setpoint is not trended. `camber datasets config irish-ahu --exercise air-sat-reset--irish-ahu --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. supply_air_reset infers the reset from the supply air (DaTemp) against the unit's own outdoor sensor (OaTemp) over the cooling hours (cooling valve open); supply_air_reset_compliance compares it with the Guideline 36 OAT reset target at its defaults. The unit runs around the clock and trends no fan signal, so neither rule is fan-gated, and occupancy falls back to CAMBER's assumed weekday schedule.
